business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Retail of Home Hydroponics and Gardening Equipment

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary republic, single national company registry system)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European doctrine, unitary national)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–European Union Free Trade Agreement (provisionally applied 2013)
Colombia–Spain Reciprocal Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement (RIPPA, 2007)
Colombia–Mexico Tax Cooperation and Avoidance Treaty (negotiated, pending final ratification)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 526 of 1999 (creation of UIAF), Law 1121 of 2006 (PEP and anti-terrorism obligations), Decree 1674 of 2016 (beneficial ownership reporting standards), Resolution 000164 of 2020 (DIAN UBO reporting), Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular 100-000005 of 2020 (AML/CFT for social companies), and Law 2155 of 2021 (universal UBO registration in the Commercial Registry).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National Civil Registry or Passport Agency of the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague member states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or equivalent corporate authorization for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or corporate secretary in the corporate shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague member states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized UBO declaration and source-of-funds affidavit
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague member states)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing a Colombian legal representative (if foreign incorporators are absent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary or competent authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or Consular Legalization for non-Hague member states)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all natural-person shareholders, UBOs, and legal representatives against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU Autonomous Sanctions Database, and Colombian UIAF-issued risk lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP as defined in Law 1121 of 2006 and FATF Rec. 12; an independent verification of direct and indirect control chain is completed before incorporation and documented for retention.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) – www.rues.org.co; actual filing through the authorized local Cámara de Comercio portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All registered company names must use Latin alphabetical characters. Spanish is the official language, and any foreign-language trade name (primarily English for e-commerce) must be accompanied by a Spanish descriptive activity line at the time of registration; a partial translocation or direct translation is accepted for the statutory name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name is rejected by the Cámara de Comercio, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal within 5 business days to the same Cámara, attaching corrected supporting documentation. If the Cámara sustains the rejection, the appellant may appeal to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) within 10 business days. Concurrently, a new homologous search can be requested without prejudice to the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted only for administrative and mailing functions; a physical address in Colombia is mandatory for service of process and inspection. For online retail of hydroponics and gardening equipment, a co-working or serviced office is acceptable if it is actually staffed during business hours and records are available on-site. The majority of operational substance—including decision-making, supply-chain management, customer service, and accounting records—must remain in Colombia to avoid income tax residency challenges.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 3–5% per year based on the Low_Risk_Standard AML classification of online household/gardening equipment retail; the likelihood increases to approximately 10% if the company fails to file initial incorporation reports or exhibits anomalous payment-rail behavior.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonym search fee (Cámara de Comercio)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Bogotá Chamber of Commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the national Chamber of Commerce fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: S.A.S. incorporation filing and RUES registry processing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration and information validation (Registro Único de Beneficios Finales)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Administrative service fee (Law 2155 of 2021; SIC tariffs)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille for four foreign-issued corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Colombian Ministry of Foreign Affairs or local notary performing apostille
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed national fee of approx. COP 12,000 per document (USD equivalent)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of S.A.S. articles of incorporation, shareholder agreement annex, and AML due-diligence pack

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Arts. 1–5, 17–22, 31, 45–46; Código de Comercio de Colombia (Decreto 410 de 1971), Arts. 110–115, 151–153; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Title III (Registro Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción correspondiente (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) / Superintendencia de Sociedades (oversight and special proceedings).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución de Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada; inscribed in the Registro Mercantil. If real property or assets exceed 1,400 UVT, a public deed before a Notary is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum authorized or paid-up capital under Ley 1258 de 2008. At least one share must be subscribed and issued; capital may be paid in instalments up to two years unless paid-in capital is agreed to be immediate. No statutory escrow account rule is imposed; any escrow is voluntary unless bylaws so provide.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE FIRST BOARD MEETING

By unanimous consent, pursuant to Ley 1258 de 2008 and the by-laws, IT IS RESOLVED:

1. The subscription of the ordinary shares is ratified and the paid-in capital is approved.
2. The registered office is located at [address, city, department], Colombia, and may be registered with the Chamber of Commerce.
3. Officers appointed: [Name] as legal representative, [Name] as alternate, and [Name] as secretary.
4. The legal representative is authorized to file registration documents before the Chamber of Commerce, DIAN and banks and to open corporate accounts.

Adopted on [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and execute the S.A.S. incorporation document
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local attorney / Notary Public (if public deed is required); Cámara de Comercio for name availability check.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución in Spanish with the S.A.S. by-laws compliant with Ley 1258/2008, including corporate purpose (online retail of hydroponics equipment), share classes, capital, governance, and legal representation. If contributions include real estate or value > 1,400 UVT, formalize by deed before a notary; otherwise sign privately. Verify with the Chamber of Commerce the unavailability of the proposed corporate name (certificado de homónimos).
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate name
Homonym certificate issued by Cámara de Comercio
Identification documents (cédula/passport) of each shareholder
Draft by-laws / incorporation document
Power of attorney if represented
RUT pre-registration or request for NIT (if available)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber rejects the name or any by-law clause, amend the by-laws or select a new name and resubmit. Formal query response is expected within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company in the commercial registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (Registro Mercantil) through the RUES portal or physical window.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation document and pay the registration fee through the Cámara's virtual registration system or in-person window. Legalize original signatures, obtain the certificate of existence and legal representation, and finalize the RUES filing.
required_dossiers: Original incorporation document signed by all subscribers
RUT pre-registration assigned by DIAN
Certificate of name availability (homonym check)
Formulario de Registro (RUES)
Identity documents and citizenship cards of shareholders and legal representative
Payment of registration fee and stamp taxes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registration has defects, the Chamber issues a 'requerimiento' specifying corrections. Correct the inconsistencies and resubmit within 10 calendar days to preserve priority and avoid a new filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete tax registration (RUT/NIT) and activate fiscal obligations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) – MUISCA portal; RUES for electronic integration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the DIAN electronic portal and complete the RUT (Registro Último Tributario) until the NIT is assigned. Update the RUT with the final registration data from the Chamber's certificate, attach the certified commercial registry record, and enable the required tax obligations, including electronic invoicing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of existence and legal representation issued by the Chamber (dated not older than 30 days)
Company RUT pre-registration and approved NIT confirmation
Board resolution appointing legal representative
Representative's identity card and personal RUT
Municipal operating permit or declared non-applicability if required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUT process fails because of missing information or electronic-signature validation, correct the form in the MUISCA portal and generate a new RUT. Re-validate the representative's digital signature with DIAN or proceed through an authorized tax agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open a corporate bank account and deposit paid-in capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial banking entity in Colombia (e.g., Bancolombia, Davivienda, Banco de Bogotá) under AML/KYC rules; subject to DIAN and UIAF controls.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the corporate registration certificate and RUT to open a corporate current account. Complete the bank's internal KYC forms and provide beneficial ownership declarations. Deposit the subscribed paid-in capital (if any) to the company's account and preserve the deposit receipt as evidence of capital payment.
required_dossiers: Original certification of existence and legal representation (date less than 30 days)
Company and shareholders RUT/NIT
Beneficial-owner declaration per UIAF rules
Board resolution appointing officers and authorizing bank operations
Passports/cédulas of signatories and shareholders
Evidence of registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional beneficial-ownership documentation, obtain an updated corporate certificate and supply the requested constitutional statements. If the application is delayed, the legal representative may file a complaint through the entity's customer service channel and provide a certificado de existencia updated within the previous month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register corporate books, municipal operating notice, and post-filing registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio (book legalization); municipal office (Secretaría de Planeación or Secretaría de Gobierno) for Aviso de Operación; DIAN for invoice authorization.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the corporate books (shareholders' minutes, share register, board minutes) to the Cámara for legalization. Confirm whether the business premises require a municipal operating notice (Aviso de Operación) or an industrial/commercial license; for an online-only home-based selling model no zoning permit is generally required, but obtain a written declaration of non-applicability if possible. Activate electronic invoicing and request the resolution de facturación from DIAN.
required_dossiers: Certificate of legalization of corporate books
RUT with updated obligations and resolution de facturación
Lease agreement or minutes declaring the registered office (including home-office use)
Certified municipal zoning form (if physical premises exist)
Proof of submitted Aviso de Operación or non-applicability rationale
ICA (industry and commerce) registration form where applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Cámara finds insufficient book annotations, correct and resubmit any book record; pay re-legalization fees if necessary. If municipal authorities request an Aviso de Operación not previously required, file the form retroactively and follow the simplified process to avoid administrative proceedings.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – the company is engaged in online retail of home hydroponics and gardening equipment and carries out no manufacturing, transformation, or industrial production activity. No industrial licensing board applies.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required – no operating or manufacturing permit is mandated for this e-commerce model. A municipal commercial operating notice (Aviso de Operación) may be required, but online-only home offices are generally exempt if there is no public access or inventory in large volumes.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporaciones Autónomas Regionales (CAR) / Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) – not applicable to pure retail sales of gardening equipment.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no full Environmental Impact Assessment or environmental registration is required for storage, importation, and online sale of non-hazardous hydroponic equipment and consumable nutrients. The activity does not fall under lists of projects requiring environmental licensing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable – the commercial activity generates no process wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste. General municipal solid waste management standards apply; if any minimal warehousing is conducted, compliance with local waste segregation and battery recycling ordinances must be maintained.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For home-office and pure e-commerce operations, no broad fire-safety or structural-load certificate is required. If a warehouse or storage space of more than 30 m² is operated, it must comply with Resolution 0312 of 2019 (minimum occupational health and safety implementation), NFPA or Colombian fire-safety standards (NTC 5246), and obtain an inspection certificate from the local fire department ('cuerpo de bomberos') for the storage area.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); official portal for registration and electronic services: https://www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through registration in the DIAN single registry (Registro Único Tributario – RUT). The SOP is: (1) appoint a resident legal representative or agent with an authenticated power of attorney; (2) legalize the company's incorporation documents in Colombia through apostille/consularization and sworn translation; (3) register with the Chamber of Commerce if exercising commercial activities or use DIAN's virtual RUT pre-registration for non-commercial foreign suppliers; (4) validate identity and submit the RUT declaring the elected income tax and VAT responsibilities; (5) upon approval, obtain the certified RUT containing the assigned NIT; and (6) obtain a digital signature certificate issued by a certification authority licensed for electronic filing and electronic invoicing with DIAN.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A Colombian S.A.S. is a juridical person and national resident taxpayer; it is taxed at entity level on its worldwide income and gains under ordinary corporate rules, not as a pass-through. There is no minimum capital requirement, but all shareholder, legal representative and company ownership information must be included in the RUT and the Chamber of Commerce registry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombian law does not provide a check-the-box election; a S.A.S. cannot elect pass-through treatment. Eligible taxpayers may opt for the optional SIMPLE regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación) through DIAN on an annual basis where gross revenues do not exceed 80,000 UVT (approximately COP 3.79 billion for the 2024 UVT) and the economic activity is eligible; this regime substitutes certain income tax, VAT and other taxes with a combined installment payment. There is no standalone local hybrid mismatch election; hybrid structures are addressed through general BEPS-aligned transfer pricing, substance and anti-abuse rules, and no elective domestic treatment is available for hybrid mismatches.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto sobre las Ventas / Value Added Tax (IVA), applicable to taxable sales of goods, services and imports in Colombia, including e-commerce deliveries to Colombian customers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general monetary threshold exists: any person engaged in taxable sales, services, or imports must register in the RUT as an IVA responsible party before undertaking the first taxable operation. For goods sold through e-commerce, VAT liabilities arise when the goods are imported or delivered into the Colombian customs territory. For the optional SIMPLE regime, the ceiling is 80,000 UVT (approximately COP 3.79 billion in 2024). Non-resident suppliers of digital services are separately required to register with DIAN from the first B2C sale without any minimum turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Colombia operates a mandatory pre-validation electronic invoicing system (facturación electrónica) through DIAN. Taxable sellers must issue invoices electronically using an authorized technology provider in XML or UBL format and transmit them to DIAN's validation/clearance platform in near real time in accordance with DIAN's operating schedule. Every valid invoice must include the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica), the QR code and the DIAN digital stamp; export transactions must be reported through the relevant electronic export documentation, the electronic purchase ledger and the periodic IVA return. Invoices not validated by DIAN are legally ineffective and expose the issuer to penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods from Colombian customs territory by registered exporters are excluded from IVA (0%), and the exporter may offset or claim refund of input VAT attributable to the exported goods and directly related production or marketing costs. To qualify, the operation must satisfy general export substance requirements: a genuine sale to a non-resident purchaser, physical departure of the goods from Colombia under a valid customs export declaration (DEX), compliance with Colombian foreign-exchange regulations through repatriation of the export revenues, and documentary evidence of delivery, payment and transfer of title to the foreign buyer. Export of services is similarly eligible where rendered to a foreign beneficiary from Colombian territory and meets the statutory conditions for exportable services.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DEX) validly lodged with DIAN and accepted by the customs clearance system
Transport document: Bill of Lading (sea) or Air Waybill (air) evidencing shipment from Colombian customs territory
Commercial invoice and packing list identifying the buyer, goods, terms of sale and HS codes of the hydroponics/gardening equipment
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) issued by an authorized Colombian foreign-exchange intermediary, proving collection of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN will verify export VAT exclusions by matching the DEX, transport documents, foreign-exchange settlement certificates, payment flows and the nature of the goods. If the export position is false, unsupported or undocumented, DIAN may assess VAT at 19% on the invoiced value, impose moratory interest, apply the inaccuracy penalty of up to 200% of the resulting tax difference depending on the severity, order full clawback of previously refunded or credited input VAT, and refer the matter to customs and criminal enforcement under the Colombian customs fraud and anti-contraband regime. Repeated violations may additionally result in enhanced penalties, suspension or cancellation of exporter registration and seizure of goods in transit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) and the Comisión de Cambios (Exchange Commission) under the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia maintains a managed floating exchange rate regime. Current-account transactions are freely convertible through authorized foreign-exchange intermediaries (IMC). Capital-account transactions require registration with the Banco de la República; foreign direct investment (FDI) must be channeled through the exchange market and is subject to a two-year minimum permanence period for capital repatriation, except in liquidation scenarios. Profit remittances are permitted after submission of the official FDI return (Formulario No. 3) and satisfaction of applicable corporate taxes; no additional transfer taxes are imposed on remittances. The system is characterized by broad convertibility with targeted administrative controls for export proceeds and investment registration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds from goods must be collected and repatriated within six months from the date of the bill of lading, and service proceeds within six months from the date of rendering. Mandatory surrender of 100% of export proceeds is required through an authorized IMC; the exporter must obtain a conversion of foreign currency into COP. Settlement is evidenced by a Comprobante de Compra de Divisas issued by the IMC, and a Declaración de Cambio must be filed in accordance with Banco de la República regulations (Circular DCIN-350).

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP and foreign-currency sub-account) for e-commerce collection and disbursement
Capital Escrow Account for foreign direct investment injection and subsequent registration
Operational Account (COP) with enhanced cross-border payment capabilities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Offshore digital electronic money institutions (EMIs) such as Wise or Revolut do not possess a Colombian financial license and cannot accept deposits or provide formal FX settlement under the exchange market regime. They may be used only as auxiliary collection channels for occasional retail e-commerce payments, provided that the funds are subsequently routed to an approved IMC in compliance with the wiring regulations. SEdPES (Sociedades Especializadas en Depósitos Electrónicos) are the only locally authorized digital deposit institutions, but they do not yet support full cross-border corporate treasury functions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of the legal representative or duly appointed apoderado is mandatory at the bank branch for the initial KYC interview. Remote opening is generally not permitted for a foreign-owned S.A.S. in Colombia, unless the bank has an existing relationship with the beneficial owner and a power-of-attorney is apostilled and legalized for a local officer. Videoconference interviews may be used only for the second stage of the customer-risk assessment, not as a substitute for the first in-person meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Company operates as an online-only e-commerce seller with no physical retail storefront or inventory warehouse in the jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide executed third-party logistics agreements, inventory forwarding contracts, warehousing certificates, and recent order fulfillment history; furnish site visitation photos and business continuity documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident individual holding 100% of the equity with no local tax residence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit notarized and apostilled passport, clean criminal record certificate, comprehensive source-of-wealth statement, and the investor's tax ID number; provide registered lease agreement for the Colombian head office and a local public-accountant certification of the company's physical operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-volume cross-border merchant receipts from PayPal/Stripe and other online processors with multiple foreign counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide merchant-service agreements, projected transaction volumes, historical statements of payment-processor accounts, and a risk-based explanation of the customer base; include implementing annex on AML/ATF policies and beneficial-ownership declaration with granular breakdown of ultimate beneficiaries.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Hydroponics equipment class may be misinterpreted as agricultural or controlled substance paraphernalia
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver Colombian customs tariff classification (HS code) certificate for ISIC 4791 items, product catalog with safety characterization, licenses from Instituto Colombiano Agropecuario (ICA) where applicable, and declarations that the goods are exclusively for lawful home horticulture.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign investors shall transfer capital through SWIFT MT103 to the account held at the local IMC (e.g., Banco de Bogotá), using purpose code 'Foreign Direct Investment – Establishment of New Enterprise' (Código de Inversión: 410). The wire must include the name and tax ID of the Colombian S.A.S. The receiving bank will issue a Comprobante de Compra de Divisas, and the company must submit Formulario No. 3 (Declaración de Cambio por Inversiones Internacionales) through the IMC within 30 working days. Back-to-back documentation includes: the capital contribution resolution of the shareholder, certificate of incorporation of the S.A.S., a post-closing corporate bank statement, and the legalized passport of the contributor.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlement with hydroponics equipment suppliers, payables are executed via SWIFT MT103 using import purpose code 'Import of Goods – Formulario No. 4' (Declaración de Cambio por Servicios y Transferencias). For large-value or recurring supply contracts, open an irrevocable standby or documentary letter of credit under UCP600 through the IMC using MT700/MT707; sender and beneficiary must provide commercial invoices, transport documents, and packing lists. Direct payments via commercial LC and MT103 are compliant provided each transfer is backed by an import declaration registered with the DIAN customs system.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Local COP forward contracts (promesas de compra/venta de divisas) transacted through IMC with two-way cash settlement in COP
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) on USD-COP executed offshore with settlement in USD or COP according to Banco de la República's current confirmation standards
Cross-currency swap agreements (CCS) for USD-COP or EUR-COP used strictly to hedge balance-sheet or operational currency exposure

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: The S.A.S. pays entity-level income tax at the general 35% rate on net taxable income. No statutory tax holiday applies to online retail or hydroponics equipment distribution in Colombia. Ordinary deductions are available for cost of sales, operating expenses, depreciation, and payroll-related outlays. Preferential 20% regime is only available in authorized Free Trade Zones; the 26% orange-economy regime applies to creative software services and not to hardware/trade transactions, so it is not relied upon in this scope.
